basics.name: Dave Beach
basics.heroText2: A freelance developer that gets shit done
basics.summary: I’m a software engineer and geospatial practitioner focused on exploration, documentation, and making complex systems understandable. My work sits at the intersection of code, maps, and fieldwork; building tools, visualizations, and datasets that support real-world discovery. Whether I’m developing software, processing geospatial data, or mapping sites deep in the backcountry, my goal is the same: create work that’s technically solid, visually clear, and grounded in purpose.

projects.title: Northern Venture Drone Services Website
projects.description: A fast, modern, and visually immersive website built to showcase professional drone mapping and aerial services in Ontario. Designed to reflect the spirit of exploration and precision behind the brand, it combines sleek performance with subtle motion and a modern aesthetic.
subDescription: Built with Astro + React: Delivers lightning-fast performance and seamless component-driven design.
Styled with TailwindCSS: Clean, responsive layout optimized for all screen sizes.
Enhanced with GSAP Animations: Smooth, natural motion effects that create an engaging, cinematic feel.
Focused on Clarity and Impact: Bold visuals, concise messaging, and an intuitive structure that communicates professionalism and trust.

experience.name: Northern Venture Drone Services
experience.summary: Building a specialized aerial services company at the intersection of drone technology, geospatial data, and field documentation. Northern Venture delivers aerial surveys, photogrammetric mapping, and infrastructure inspections across sectors including construction, utilities, mining, forestry, and heritage preservation.
responsibilities: Design and execute drone operations for photogrammetric 3D mapping, aerial survey, and site inspection, producing publication-quality spatial datasets and high-resolution visualizations
Lead all aspects of business development, client acquisition, and regulatory compliance, including Transport Canada Advanced Operations certification
Apply geospatial processing pipelines to aerial data, delivering actionable reports and decision-support outputs to stakeholders

experience.name: SkyWatch
experience.summary: SkyWatch operates one of the world's largest satellite imagery marketplaces, aggregating data from dozens of commercial and government earth observation providers. As engineering team lead, I directed a front-end team of three engineers across a suite of web applications serving thousands of customers globally — from independent researchers to enterprise geospatial operations.
responsibilities: Led the design and development of a native integration between the SkyWatch EarthCache imagery marketplace and Esri's ArcGIS Pro, bringing seamless satellite data purchasing directly into the workflows of the world's most widely used professional GIS platform.
Architected Angular- and React-based front-end applications in a monorepo pattern, leveraging NgRx state management and AWS infrastructure
Grew and mentored a front-end engineering team with individualized development plans, improving delivery consistency and team retention
Drove front-end recruitment, including interview design and candidate evaluation
Established design systems, testing procedures, and CI/CD pipeline improvements that reduced release friction across the engineering org

experience.name: Saatchi and Saatchi Canada (TPM Division)
experience.summary: A decade embedded with Toyota and Lexus Canada's digital presence, leading development across consumer-facing marketing sites and enterprise manufacturing systems. The Toyota Canada and Lexus Canada websites served millions of monthly visitors and were recognized twice by J.D. Power & Associates as the best automotive OEM websites in Canada.
responsibilities: Designed, built, and physically deployed a complete hardware-software kiosk system across Toyota Motor Manufacturing Canada's plant facilities. The kiosks, installed at security checkpoints at 3 TMMC locations, replaced a manual contractor onboarding process with a self-serve digital training, testing, and certification workflow, significantly reducing administrative overhead and improving compliance tracking for contractors entering active manufacturing sites.

Led a front-end rebuild of Toyota Motor Manufacturing Canada's internal intranet, migrating legacy applications to a modern architecture and improving accessibility and maintainability for the internal user base across manufacturing operations.
Led development of Toyota and Lexus Canada consumer sites serving millions of monthly visitors, winning back-to-back J.D. Power awards for best Canadian automotive OEM website (Lexus, Toyota)
Delivered Canada's first responsive luxury automotive websites for Lexus, setting a new benchmark for the industry
Architected full-stack solutions across Angular, Laravel, WordPress, Java/Struts, and Freemarker
Led the agency's transition from waterfall to agile methodology, onboarding technical and non-technical team members alike

experience.name: Him & Her Inc.
experience.summary: Led a cross-functional team of developers and contractors, directing project delivery and technical strategy for a portfolio of high-end client work.
responsibilities: Directed the development of a flagship e-commerce platform for Raffi Jewellers, one of Canada's most prominent luxury jewellery retailers. The project earned formal recognition from Rolex for excellence in brand representation.
Reduced technical debt and established project roadmaps that improved team delivery velocity
Architected and delivered complex e-commerce platforms in close partnership with clients and vendors
Supported team growth through regular one-on-ones and individualized development support

experience.summary: Agency and freelance development across a range of industries and clients, including TunnelBear (VPN startup, subscription platform and marketing site), Blast Radius (Scott's Miracle-Gro CMS), and brand work for Nintendo, Molson, Coca-Cola, and Mercedes-Benz. Built a foundation in full-stack development, client communication, and delivering production-grade work across diverse technical environments.
